messages:
sara_acme: Hi, we started seeing invalid/changed structured output after last night's canary. Our webhook parser throws because top-level order_id is missing and items is coming back as a string (escaped JSON) instead of an array. Request id: req_0a1b2c. Model: redwood/llamaX-5b-v3. Rolling back the model to the previous tag fixes it for us. Latency also jumped from ~120ms to ~340ms for these calls. Can you look?

alex_support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a minimal request + the exact response you got? Which tenant/route is this on? We'll escalate to eng once we have a repro.

sara_acme: Minimal request (POST /v1/chat/completions):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/llamaX-5b-v3",
  "json_mode": true,
  "prompt": "Produce order JSON for order #12345 with items list",
  "max_tokens": 200
}
```
Response we received (excerpt):
```json
{
  "order_id": null,
  "items": "[{\"sku\":\"ABC-123\",\"qty\":1}]",
  "total": 19.99
}
```
So items is a string containing escaped JSON instead of an actual array, and order_id is null even though the old model returned the id. Tenant: acme-corp (tenant_id: t-acme-09).

maria_eng: Do you know if the customer was using streaming (chunked) responses or non-streaming? Also, are they using function-calling or structured-output mode? Trying to narrow if it's a postprocessing encoder or a streaming chunk reassembly bug.

sara_acme: Non-streaming (we set stream=false). Using structured-output/json_mode. No function-calling. Full response header + body attached:
```
X-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c
Content-Type: application/json
```
Full body same as above. We confirmed after pinning the older model tag responses are correct. We also saw an uptick in token counts (doubled) for those responses — probably because JSON was escaped.

jordan_ml: We briefly saw odd behavior in the new output-formatter v2 that was rolled with the canary: it sometimes JSON-encodes nested objects into strings as a defensive measure when it detects unescaped quotes from model output. That encoder path should only run for streaming sanitization, but a routing bug enabled it for non-streaming redwood/llamaX-5b-v3.

alex_support: deploy-bot: can you confirm rollout windows?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for output-formatter:v2 -> 8% of hosts (2026-03-16 22:12:05 UTC). Change-id: fmt-v2-canary-2026-03-16.

ops_oncall: We can route tenant t-acme-09 to stable while you push a fix. Do you want us to add a temporary routing rule (tenant=t-acme-09 -> stable) now? This will stop them hitting canary hosts.

sara_acme: Please do that — our production parser is failing and we have live orders. Also, the billing system flagged higher token usage for the tenant during last 6 hours (looks correlated). We'll need a billing adjustment/credit if this caused over-usage.

alex_support: Understood. I'll create a support ticket and a billing case. Can you share the invoice id or the tenant billing ref? I'll also request temporary credits.

sara_acme: Tenant billing id: bill-acme-778. Invoice id: inv-2026-03-15-99.

maria_eng: I've reproduced locally with the customer's prompt set and confirmed the encoder is being applied to non-streaming responses due to an edge in the host routing table. Pushing a rollback/guard: disable encoder v2 for non-streaming paths (change fmt-guard-rollback-2026-03-16). @jordan_ml can you run the nested-object unit tests and integration test with acme prompts?

jordan_ml: Running tests now against a canary snapshot. I can reproduce the escaped-json-in-string behavior and the null order_id in the same trace. Patch fixes locally; will push to canary in ~30m and verify with the customer's request id. Also adding a regression test that asserts nested arrays remain arrays for json_mode=true.

sara_acme: Thanks — after ops_oncall routed us to stable our webhooks are back to green. Please confirm when canary is patched and we'll re-enable traffic.

alex_support: Ticket created SUP-7894, billing case BILL-4321 (requested temporary credits pending investigation). Will follow up once canary is patched and we validate with the customer's example.

maria_eng: Patch deployed to canary and encoder v2 disabled for non-streaming. Monitoring now. Change-id: fmt-rollback-2026-03-16.

jordan_ml: Verified with req_0a1b2c — canary hosts now return items as arrays and order_id populated. Added post-deploy integration test to prevent regression.

sara_acme: Confirmed on our side: responses back to expected format and token counts normalized. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

alex_support: Closing interim routing. Will keep SUP-7894 open until you sign off fully. :thumbsup:
